topics.title: How adult ADHD and autism are diagnosed
topics.scope: The diagnostic process for adult ADHD and ASD: anamnesis, observation and tests, what EEG/MRI/genetic panels cannot show, ICD codes, finding a competent psychiatrist, Russian state vs private care and diagnosis abroad.

topics.title: Differential diagnosis: ADHD and autism vs bipolar, depression, BPD and OCPD
topics.scope: How to tell ADHD energy cycles, autistic burnout and neurodevelopmental conditions apart from bipolar II, hypomania, dysthymia, depression, BPD and OCPD, and why the 'neurodivergent umbrella' should not cover treatable disorders.

topics.title: ADHD and autism in women: phenotype, masking and hormones
topics.scope: Why women with ADHD/ASD are diagnosed late, how they mask, sex-difference study data, and how estrogen, the menstrual cycle and menopause change ADHD symptoms.

topics.title: Self-diagnosis, myths and stigma around neurodivergence
topics.scope: Social-media self-diagnosis, the rise in diagnoses and 'everyone is neurodivergent', medical vs social model, common myths, anti-ADHD misinformation, the autism driving ban and stigma among professionals.

topics.title: Autism spectrum: support levels, genetics and history
topics.scope: ASD support levels 1–3 and why they replaced Asperger/Kanner labels, low support needs still being a disability, heritability and twin data, autistic traits in parents, autistic parenting, historical pioneers and starter resources.

topics.title: Meltdowns, shutdowns and acute overload
topics.scope: What meltdowns, shutdowns and empty-mind states look like in autistic and ADHD adults, why acute stress recovery takes longer, and practical prevention kits for new places, films and travel.

topics.title: Autistic and ADHD burnout, fatigue and limited energy
topics.scope: Autistic burnout vs depression, the ADHD work-burnout cycle, why neurodivergent people tire faster (sensory load, task switching), planning by energy, and using ChatGPT to offload executive function during burnout.

topics.title: How neurodivergent people rest and recover
topics.scope: Three kinds of rest (stillness, process activity, resource activity), learning to do nothing, planning rest, social recovery, returning after holidays, resilience as flexibility, and the annual year-review ritual.

topics.title: Building and using your sensory profile
topics.scope: Hyper-, hypo- and mixed sensitivity across the sensory systems (interoception, vision, touch, smell, temperature), sensory seeking, how to map your own profile and concrete adaptations like lighting, clothing, weighted blankets and sensory kits.

topics.title: Stimming, special interests and repetitive behaviours
topics.scope: Functions of stimming, telling stimming from OCD-like hair pulling and skin picking by function, and how a special interest differs from a hobby and hyperfixation and serves as a resource.

topics.title: Physical comorbidities: sleep, pain, migraine and eating
topics.scope: Sleep problems and daytime sleepiness in ASD/ADHD, pain in dreams and PTSD nightmares, migraine, chronic muscle pain and hypermobility, connective tissue dysplasia, sensory eating difficulties, ADHD sweet cravings and nutrition mixes for bad days.

topics.title: Masking, compensation and unmasking
topics.scope: How masking forms (e.g. learning to 'endure' sensory discomfort), its costs and late decompensation after 30, and what unmasking looks like in practice.

topics.title: Autistic communication, belonging and being misread
topics.scope: The double empathy problem, mismatch between inner feelings and nonverbal signals, trusted companions in public places, need for a small safe tribe, social anxiety vs limited social energy at work.

topics.title: Executive dysfunction, environment and work
topics.scope: What executive dysfunction is, the four ADHD neural circuits, autistic inertia, ADHD tax and planning failures, the unstable sense of self (DMN), changing environment and context, and choosing a profession and work format.

topics.title: ADHD skills training, coaching and organization tools
topics.scope: CBT skills groups for ADHD (structure, pre-group interview, why no ASD+ADHD groups), ADHD coaching, capture lists and planning apps, returning to reading, and why skills fade and must be relearned.

topics.title: Emotional dysregulation, rejection sensitivity and relationships
topics.scope: Emotional sensitivity in ADHD and autism, a critical look at rejection sensitive dysphoria, tracking emotions as signals, anger outbursts and responsibility in relationships, and why ADHD does not excuse infidelity.

domains.domain: Psychiatric treatment and mental health care

topics.title: Psychiatric medication: ADHD drugs and antidepressants
topics.scope: Atomoxetine and stimulants, availability in Russia, treatment order in ASD+ADHD, why to try ADHD meds, antidepressant dose stigma, tapering without withdrawal, and personal experience of the right antidepressant.

topics.title: Choosing specialists and evidence-based mental health care
topics.scope: Finding a psychiatrist or psychologist, online second opinions, why private psychiatry is expensive, psychotherapy as medicine following clinical guidelines, stigma of psychiatric symptoms in somatic medicine, trusting patients' anamnesis, and whom to see for grief.

topics.title: Health policy and healthcare systems
topics.scope: Lessons from a health-policy course: measuring health, history of insurance medicine in Russia, health spending vs life expectancy, GP prescribing and psychiatrist prices, and the medical graduate 'mentoring' law.

topics.title: Anxiety, phobias, panic and OCD: exposure and self-observation
topics.scope: Gradual exposure as the most effective long-term treatment for fears, phobias and panic, medication as safety behaviour in panic disorder, and self-monitoring OCD with the Y-BOCS scale.

topics.title: Coping with terror attacks and collective tragedy
topics.scope: How terror attacks create unpredictability and split society, defensive reactions like calls for the death penalty as illusions of control, and first-aid steps after a tragedy.

topics.title: Behavioral activation, movement and mindfulness for mood
topics.scope: Walks and behavioral activation for ADHD and mood, a plan for the November slump, sleep/movement/safety for neuroplasticity, short mindfulness for ADHD, and happiness heritability.

topics.title: Inner critic, schema therapy and soothing the threat system
topics.scope: Origins and modes of the inner critic in schema therapy, RO DBT safety skills, gratitude and loving-kindness to lower threat, plus reviews of books and an imagery audio play on self-criticism, narcissism and therapeutic conversation.
